{{Quote|Poor little Yalt with his bossy wife.|[[Juda]]|<ref name="TOR:SAYR">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Settling Accounts: Yalt Reward|Hutta}}</ref>}}
'''Yalt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the polluted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yalt's wife works there. She encouraged his disloyalty to me. Give Yalt's head to her.|[[Suudaa Nem'ro]]|<ref name="TOR:SA" />}}
The woman was the wife of [[Yalt]], an accountant who worked directly for [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro the Hutt]]. After Yalt betrayed Nem'ro for [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra]] at his wife's suggestion, Nem'ro tasked a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] seeking a place in the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="TOR:SA" />

{{GameDS}}
After succeeding in killing the accountant, the hunter brought Yalt's head to his wife at [[Nem'ro's Palace]], after which she fled in horror.<ref name="TOR:SA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the player chooses to let Yalt live, both he and his wife flee Nal Hutta and are not seen again.<ref name="TOR:SA" />
